title: FMCSA Carrier Intelligence
description: Detect current FMCSA insurance deficiencies and newly changed carrier-risk signals over time.

changesOnly.title: Only return new changes
changesOnly.description: When enabled, repeated runs return only newly detected or changed FMCSA signals. The first run establishes a baseline and returns current deficient carriers as new insurance-gap signals.

includeInactive.title: Include inactive authorities
includeInactive.description: Include carriers whose operating authority is inactive or withdrawn.

minCoverageGap.title: Minimum coverage gap ($)
minCoverageGap.description: Minimum dollar difference between required BI&PD coverage and coverage currently on file.

minScore.title: Minimum signal score
minScore.description: Only return carrier signals whose deterministic opportunity score meets this threshold.

maxResults.title: Maximum signals
maxResults.description: Maximum number of intelligence signals to return in one run.

maxSourceRows.title: Maximum source rows to scan
maxSourceRows.description: Safety limit for paginated FMCSA deficient-carrier records scanned per run.
